title: Essex couple transform their garden with miniature railway
summary_full: Dave and Angela Walker, a couple from Clacton-on-Sea, dedicated eight years to building a miniature railway. Their project spans approximately 400 metres throughout their quarter-acre garden, showcasing various collected memorabilia. Despite opinions from others, they find joy in their shared achievement and partnership. The couple plans to open their railway for community fundraising events benefiting the local lifeboat station.
